title: Viral DNA and RNA Extraction from Faecal Specimens using QIAamp MinElute Virus Kits
author: Naluepanat Yodjan

steps.title: Homogenize Faecal Specimens
steps.instruction: Vigorously vortex and homogenize faecal specimens for 5 min.

steps.title: Collect Supernatants
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenized specimens at 15,000 x g for 10 min and collect the supernatants.

steps.title: Filter Supernatants
steps.instruction: Filter approximately 200 µl of the supernatant from each sample through a 0.45 µm filter and a 0.2 µm filter to remove eukaryotic cell and bacterium-sized particles.

steps.title: Digest Unprotected Nucleic Acids
steps.instruction: Digest the filtrates using DNase and RNase to remove unprotected nucleic acids.

steps.title: Prepare Lysate
steps.instruction: Combine protease and filtered supernatants in a microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 25 µl of Protease or Proteinase K into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 200 µl of filtered supernatants into the tube.

steps.title: Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Add Buffer AL and incubate the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µl Buffer AL containing 28 µg/ml of carrier RNA to the tube.
Incubate at 56°C for 15 minutes in a heating block or water bath.

steps.title: Ethanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add ethanol to the lysate and mix.

substeps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the 1.5 ml tube to remove drops from the inside of the lid.
Add 250 µl of ethanol (96–100%) to the sample.
Close the cap and mix thoroughly by pulse-vortexing for 15 s.
Incubate the lysate with the ethanol for 5 min at room temperature (15–25°C).

steps.title: Load QIAamp MinElute Column
steps.instruction: Apply the lysate to the spin column and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the 1.5 ml tube to remove drops from the inside of the lid.
Carefully apply all of the lysate onto the QIAamp MinElute column without wetting the rim.
Close the cap and centrifuge at 6000 x g (8000 rpm) for 1 min.
Place the column in a clean 2 ml collection tube and discard the previous collection tube containing the filtrate.

steps.title: Wash Column with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane using Buffer AW1.

substeps.instruction: Carefully open the QIAamp MinElute column and add 500 µl of Buffer AW1 without wetting the rim.
Close the cap and centrifuge at 6000 x g (8000 rpm) for 1 min.

steps.title: Wash Column with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane using Buffer AW2.

substeps.instruction: Carefully open the QIAamp MinElute column and add 500 µl of Buffer AW2 without wetting the rim.
Close the cap and centrifuge at 6000 x g (8000 rpm) for 1 min.

steps.title: Final Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Perform a final wash with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Carefully open the QIAamp MinElute column and add 500 µl of ethanol (96–100%) without wetting the rim.
Close the cap and centrifuge at 6000 x g (8000 rpm) for 1 min.
Discard the collection tube containing the filtrate.

steps.title: Dry the Membrane
steps.instruction: Completely dry the column membrane through centrifugation and heat.

substeps.instruction: Place the QIAamp MinElute column in a clean 2 ml collection tube.
Centrifuge at full speed (20,000 x g; 14,000 rpm) for 3 min.
Place the column into a new 2 ml collection tube, open the lid, and incubate the assembly at 56°C for 3 min.

steps.title: Elute Viral Nucleic Acids
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA/RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Place the QIAamp MinElute column in a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube and discard the collection tube.
Carefully open the lid of the column and apply 20–150 µl of Buffer AVE or RNase-free water to the centre of the membrane.
Close the lid and incubate at room temperature for 1 min.
Centrifuge at full speed (20,000 x g; 14,000 rpm) for 1 min.

steps.title: Store Nucleic Acids
steps.instruction: Store the extracted viral nucleic acids at -80 °C for further analyses.
